name: context-ontology-companion
description: Save and recover explicitly selected project context locally with provenance and revision history.

interface.longDescription: Apply relevant project context to the current task, or store, retrieve, correct, revoke and erase explicitly selected decisions and constraints. Includes separate apply/manage skills, project-scoped local MCP setup and a Python 3.11+ CLI. Preserves sources, revisions and caller-declared OS-account authorization; stored context never authorizes later actions.
defaultPrompt: Use $apply-context-ontology to apply relevant project context to this conversation and continue the current task.
Use $manage-approved-context to save my explicitly selected project requirement and verify retrieval.
